scope: KDE Chrome actual-document observation only; GNOME and other clients unchanged
first_failed_transition: A complete native document observation exceeds 20 ms during fullscreen iframe input. A final canonical KWin read then fails and correctly retires its connection lifetime; the next observation cannot reuse the old field identity.

measured_evidence.source_tests: v135-r2 75/75 PASS; this does not certify the budget change
measured_evidence.client_result: v135-r2 fullscreen text and rich PASS; iframe-rich FAIL

decision: Use a 40 ms total bound for actual-document observation. Preserve the existing 20 ms selection/edit preflight and observer subscription bounds. No retries, extra wakeups, cached proof, identity normalization, admission timeout changes or mutation authority changes.
tradeoff: An observation can occupy the serialized engine for at most 20 ms longer. Measure visible hint and Tab latency and repeat the failed physical Chrome scenario before acceptance.
required_proof: Existing bounded native transport, privacy, identity, selection and presentation tests pass
Installed engine bytes match the compiler artifact
Physical Chrome fullscreen iframe input produces a fresh joined suffix and exact Tab result
Normal, private and focus-return Chrome checks remain valid
